question: Dinesh makes four trips of equal distances. His speed on first trip was 140 km/hr and in each subsequent trip his speed was half of the previous trip. What is the average speed of Dinesh in these four trips?
solution:

Speed = 140 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Average speed = Total distance / total time
